base_extractor.config_sha256: computed at build time by build_eventrecord.rule_hash() with budget replaced; regexes unchanged
base_extractor.used: identifiers(), render(), drop_repeats(), trim_even(), build_record(), load_tokenizer(); Gemma-4-31B tokenizer

inputs: trajectory files listed in tau2/tau2_telecom/manifest.json (paths only). Policies, labels and rendered_inputs.json are not read.

calls.source: each turn's 'calls' list, in order; name and arguments (json.dumps(arguments, sort_keys=True)), as build_eventrecord.tool_calls does for list-form calls
calls.pairing: by position: the k-th call of a turn gets the k-th of the consecutive result turns that FOLLOW it (role 'tool' for actor agent, role 'user_tool' for actor user); results beyond the last call are appended to the last call; a call with no result gets an empty result
calls.user_actions: a call with actor 'user' is rendered as '<name> (user action)'; agent calls are rendered as '<name>'

identifiers_per_call_in_order: status:error when the paired result has error=true or its content starts with 'Error'

telecom fields from the call arguments, then from the paired result when it parses as JSON (json.loads, then ast.literal_eval); nested dicts and lists are walked; each scalar value under a listed key is emitted as '<key>:<value>'
status lines from a result that does not parse as JSON (STATUS_RES below)
base identifiers(call arguments text, result text) unchanged: email, url, account, amount, path, date, domain, name
dedup: within a call, by (type, casefolded value for email/domain/name, otherwise exact), as build_eventrecord
budget_source: median Gemma-token length of the untrained structured ledger (writers/a12 constructor_records record.ledger_text) on the 300 tau2 telecom trajectories; tau2/er_inspect.txt
trim: build_eventrecord.build_record unchanged: if over budget, drop identifiers already kept on an earlier call; if still over, trim each call to an equal identifier-token share
render: build_eventrecord.render: '[i] <name>' then one '<type>:<value>' line per identifier, blocks separated by a blank line
read: READ_MODE=event (record.ledger_text verbatim), same benches and hash files as the other tau2 reads
